record.question: Who is the newly appointed Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)?
record.explanation: Answer C: Rahul Johri. Rahul Johri was appointed BCCI Chief Executive Officer in 2016. BCCI's original 2015–16 annual report records ratification of his appointment, distinguishing the elected president Anurag Thakur and secretary Ajay Shirke. Historical/source note: Historical 2016 appointment; the president and honorary secretary are different offices. Reference: https://documents.bcci.tv/documents/bcci/documents/1638362349_BCCI%20Annual%20Report%202015-16.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
